notes: Both are AirPods Pro 2nd Generation. The Lightning case shipped Sept 2022; the USB-C case is the Sept 2023 refresh of the same generation. Apple markets both as 'AirPods Pro (2nd generation)'. The names point to different SKUs but the same product line — 'variant' captures this exactly.
Same processor + same product line (MacBook Air M2). Different screen sizes are SKU variants Apple sells under one product family.
Same model year, same model (Model 3). Trim levels (Long Range vs Performance) are SKU variants within one product line.
Tylenol is a brand name for the generic drug acetaminophen. Identical compound.
Colloquial vs official name for the same product.
CC is the abbreviation for Creative Cloud — identical software.
Same screen size, different product lines (Pro and Air are Apple's distinct iPad families with different chips/features/prices).
S24 Ultra is a distinct product within the S24 family (different chip in some markets, larger screen, S Pen, different camera system). Samsung sells them as separate phones, not variants.
AirPods Pro are in-ear earbuds; AirPods Max are over-ear headphones. Entirely different products.
iPhone 15 and iPhone 15 Pro are distinct products: different chip (A16 vs A17 Pro), different body material, different camera system, different price. Apple markets them as separate phones.
Two common naming conventions for the same product — '10th generation' (Apple's formal) vs 'iPad 10' (colloquial shorthand).
